manual_review_reason: The first-party four-step form requires PRO and SoundExchange registration, legal identity and royalty data, direct audio and lyrics uploads, explicit-content disclosure, promotional-media consent, broadcast authorization, a digital signature and agreement to linked Live365 terms. Airhug Radio strictly prohibits AI, so a human must confirm that the selected MarcsMusic track contains no prohibited AI-generated or AI-assisted element, verify international registration compatibility and all rights, inspect hidden live controls, and explicitly approve every upload, consent and final submission action.
